steps.title: Project Setup
steps.description: Initialize standard Android project configuration and structure for Retro Brick Breaker.

steps.title: Configure Manifest and Permissions
steps.description: Define application manifest, package attributes, screen orientation, and retro material theme.

steps.title: Define Color Resources
steps.description: Create classic arcade dark background colors, retro neon palette, and glowing brick colors.

steps.title: Define String Resources
steps.description: Add string resources for game states, HUD display labels, levels, and play screen buttons.

steps.title: Setup Application Styles
steps.description: Configure full-screen dark theme without action bar for classic arcade aesthetic.

steps.title: Create Brick Model Class
steps.description: Implement Brick entity class supporting state, position, points value, color tier, and hit registration.

steps.title: Create Particle Effect System
steps.description: Implement particle explosion effects for dynamic brick shatter animations.

steps.title: Develop Game View and Physics Engine
steps.description: Implement custom SurfaceView with game loop, ball trajectory calculations, paddle motion, brick collision detection, level progression, score management, and visual HUD drawing.

steps.title: Create Main Activity Layout
steps.description: Design responsive main layout hosting the full-screen interactive game view and retro overlay controls.

steps.title: Implement Main Activity Logic
steps.description: Connect activity lifecycle methods, full-screen flag management, high score persistence, and game state callbacks.

steps.title: Building Retro Brick Breaker
steps.description: Compile the standard native Java app and package final runnable debug APK.
